source.description:
Found while validating a live snapshot against the merged Core schema (xtrm-dev/core 92d64eeb) during xtmux #61.

The contract declares host.required = ['host_id','tmux_server_id']. topology_json emits only:
  "host":{"host_id":"..."}

So every snapshot xtmux has ever produced fails schema validation on this one property — predates the lineage work and is unrelated to it. With the agent object now widened, this is the ONLY remaining validation error:
  errors: 1
   - ['host'] 'tmux_server_id' is a required property

docs/xtmux-gaps.md 5.4 already asks to 'make the tmux server identity explicit or derivable', so the intent exists; the emitter never caught up.

Fix options: derive from the tmux socket path/pid (tmux display-message -p '#{pid}' or the socket inode) and emit host.tmux_server_id, OR ask Core to relax it to optional. Prefer emitting — a topology aggregating multiple hosts wants to distinguish two tmux servers on one host.

Deliberately NOT folded into #61, which is additive to the agent object only.
source.title: topology --json omits host.tmux_server_id, which xtrm.xtmux.topology.v1 requires
